idea-plugin.name: Ghi
idea-plugin.description: Ghi (Go, Hierarchy, Interfaces) support for GoLand. Recognizes .ghi files, highlights syntax, supports comments and brace matching, and builds or runs projects in the IDE console with clickable compiler diagnostics. Configure the compiler and project directory under Languages & Frameworks > Ghi. Requires the Ghi compiler. Supports both Class(args) and new Class(args) construction, including qualified and generic classes. Includes Ghi declaration navigation, completion, parameter information, symbol rename and compiler diagnostics for saved and unsaved existing project files. Ghi 0.2.12+ adds compiler-checked expression types in Quick Documentation, including the current unsaved file. Adds concrete generic parameter hints, including inherited generic members, embedded interface constraints, method values and parent calls, coordinated override/structural-interface rename, and native Go SDK or Mojave-pinned cache completion/navigation. Recognizes plain enums and string, int or bool backed enum cases for highlighting, navigation and completion. Ambiguous structural rename signatures raise conflicts. Selected Ghi type imports and file-local aliases support completion, navigation, hints and safe rename. Completion can insert imports; explicit intentions import unresolved types or shorten qualified type references with collision-safe aliases. Anonymous block arrow functions have scoped parameters, capture navigation and call hints. Reformat Code uses the compiler's canonical ghi fmt for the current editor buffer. Debug Project builds with source metadata and debugs .ghi files with GoLand's bundled Delve, including line breakpoints, stepping, call stacks, variables and caught exceptions.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Version 0.1.10: replace the deprecated read-action API used to validate expression type hover with a cancellable non-blocking read action. Supports GoLand platform 251+.
